bundle: ME2 voice-controlled smart device: wake word + intent + slot (ONNX, CPU)

wake.name: Hello / Hi Elkit (openWakeWord embeddings + Elkit head, job 65684)
wake.frontend: openWakeWord v0.5.1 melspectrogram + embedding models (Apache-2.0), frozen; mel input = audio * 32767, mel/10 + 2
wake.input: embeddings float32 [N,16,96] = 16 openWakeWord embeddings (one per 80 ms) = 2 s of audio
wake.output: logit [N] -> sigmoid = P(Hello Elkit or Hi Elkit)
wake.threshold_rule: chosen on DEV voices: with 2 windows in a row, the threshold that wakes on as many DEV 'Hello/Hi Elkit' phrases as the previous head (job 65357) did at its field setting 0.94 x 2; at that wake rate the new head has ~10x fewer false wakes on real sentences. Sound-alike phrases ('Hi, el kid') may wake it

alternative_rules.fewer_false_wakes: 0.94 x 2: fewer false wakes, but misses clearly more wake phrases (docs/03)

wake.training_data: TTS (Piper + Meta MMS voices) 'Hello/Hi Elkit' + confusables, real MSWC words / MLS 'el' splices, ai231 + Speech Commands negatives, 10.3 h real sentences (ai231 real voices + MLS Spanish) as negatives, DEMAND training rooms

wake_backup.training_data: Speech Commands v0.02 (official splits) + DEMAND + Speech Commands background noise
wake_backup.name: Marvin (backup wake word)

intent.name: Intent Conformer (d_model 96, 4 layers, 644k parameters)
intent.reject_rule: max softmax below threshold -> not a known command (keeps 95 % of in-scope VALIDATION commands)

slot.name: Slot TC-DSCNN (18 values, 3 per slotted intent)
slot.rule: only the 3 values of the predicted intent compete (softmax over those 3 logits)
